0.description: Explicit no rounding — flush edges, full-bleed media, table cells.

999.description: Pill sentinel, not a measured radius. Any value larger than half the height of the element renders as a semicircle, so this one token gives a fully rounded end at every size without tracking the element.

0.description: Explicit no border, for switching a border off while keeping the property bound to a token. Not referenced by any semantic or component token — it is part of the raw scale, not of the supported system.

1.description: Default hairline border — inputs, cards, dividers, and the Checkbox box.

2.description: Heavier border, used for focus rings and for the Radio circle.

bg.description: White page background, the default canvas. Containers placed directly on it use bg-surface (grey). For the grey canvas use bg-secondary. Match the suffix: bg pairs with bg-surface.

bg-secondary.description: Grey page background, the alternate canvas for screens built from stacked cards. Containers placed directly on it use bg-surface-secondary (white). bg-fill-secondary is the same grey, so segmented tracks and skeletons on this canvas need a border or a different fill. Chips are white, so they sit on this canvas without a border. Match the suffix: bg-secondary pairs with bg-surface-secondary.

bg-surface.description: Grey container placed on the white page (bg) — wells, grouped sections, list backgrounds. Match the suffix: bg pairs with bg-surface. On the grey page (bg-secondary) it has no contrast; use bg-surface-secondary there. Surface tokens colour the container behind content; bg-fill-* tokens colour the body of the element itself.

bg-surface-hover.description: Hover state for a tappable grey container on the white page (bg-surface) — list rows, grouped options. For a white card on the grey page use bg-surface-secondary-hover; for the body of a control such as a chip use bg-fill-hover.

bg-surface-pressed.description: Pressed state for a tappable grey container on the white page (bg-surface) — list rows, grouped options. For a white card on the grey page use bg-surface-secondary-pressed.

bg-surface-disabled.description: Container surface of a disabled control or section. Pair with text-disabled and border-disabled-subtle. For a disabled element that reads as solid, use bg-fill-disabled-strong or bg-fill-disabled-subtle.

bg-surface-disabled-subtle.description: Lighter disabled surface — the disabled chip, and a whole section or card that is unavailable, where bg-surface-disabled would read too heavy. Pair with text-disabled. Nearly the same as white and the grey canvas, so the disabled label carries the state.

bg-surface-secondary.description: White container placed on the grey page (bg-secondary) — cards, sheets, popovers, menus. Match the suffix: bg-secondary pairs with bg-surface-secondary. On the white page (bg) it has no contrast without a border; use bg-surface there, or add a border for a floating element.

bg-surface-secondary-hover.description: Hover state for a tappable white card, sheet row or menu item on the grey page (bg-surface-secondary). For a grey container on the white page use bg-surface-hover.

bg-surface-secondary-pressed.description: Pressed state for a tappable white card, sheet row or menu item on the grey page (bg-surface-secondary). The same grey as bg-secondary, so on the grey canvas a pressed card keeps its edge only through its border or shadow.

bg-surface-brand.description: Brand-tinted container — tertiary button default, selected list rows, brand callouts. This is a background behind content; for a solid brand element such as a primary button use bg-fill-brand.

bg-surface-brand-hover.description: Hover state for bg-surface-brand, and the hover background for brand controls that are transparent at rest (secondary and text buttons).

bg-surface-brand-pressed-subtle.description: Light pressed step for a brand-tinted surface, the same tint as bg-surface-brand-hover, for presses that should barely deepen. Pair the label with text-brand-on-bg-surface-hover. For the standard pressed state use bg-surface-brand-pressed-strong.

bg-surface-brand-pressed-strong.description: Pressed state for bg-surface-brand and for brand controls that are transparent at rest — secondary and tertiary button presses, the selected chip. Pair the label with text-brand-on-bg-surface-pressed. For a lighter press use bg-surface-brand-pressed-subtle.

bg-surface-info.description: Informational container — info banners, inline info messages. Pair with text-info, border-info and icon-info. For a solid info element such as a badge use bg-fill-info-strong.

bg-surface-info-hover.description: Hover state for an interactive info container, such as a tappable info banner. Pair the label with text-info-on-bg-surface-hover.

bg-surface-info-pressed.description: Pressed state for an interactive info container, such as a tappable info banner. Pair the label with text-info-on-bg-surface-pressed.

bg-surface-success.description: Success container — confirmation banners, completed-state panels. Pair with text-success, border-success and icon-success.

bg-surface-success-hover.description: Hover state for an interactive success container, such as a tappable confirmation banner. Pair the label with text-success-on-bg-surface-hover.

bg-surface-success-pressed.description: Pressed state for an interactive success container, such as a tappable confirmation banner. Pair the label with text-success-on-bg-surface-pressed.

bg-surface-caution.description: Caution container — amber advisory banners and inline notices. In Cosmos, caution is the amber advisory role; for errors and destructive flows use the warning tokens.

bg-surface-caution-hover.description: Hover state for an interactive caution container, such as a tappable advisory banner. Pair the label with text-caution-on-bg-surface-hover.

bg-surface-caution-pressed.description: Pressed state for an interactive caution container, such as a tappable advisory banner. Pair the label with text-caution-on-bg-surface-pressed.

bg-surface-warning.description: Error/destructive container — error banners, inline validation messages, destructive tertiary button default. In Cosmos, warning is the red error role; for amber advisories use bg-surface-caution.

bg-surface-warning-hover.description: Hover state for bg-surface-warning, and the hover background for destructive controls that are transparent at rest.

bg-surface-warning-pressed.description: Pressed/active state for bg-surface-warning and for destructive controls that are transparent at rest.

bg-surface-inverse.description: Inverted container for elements that must contrast with the page — tooltips, dark overlays, spotlight callouts. Pair with text-inverse and icon-inverse.

bg-fill.description: Default fill for the body of an interactive element — input fields, switch tracks, unselected controls. Fill tokens colour the element; bg-surface-* tokens colour the container behind it.

bg-fill-hover.description: Hover step of bg-fill for a neutral control that must stay neutral under the pointer — unselected chips, and later input fields. The same grey as bg-secondary, so on the grey canvas a borderless control loses its fill on hover and only its label remains. Use bg-surface-brand when hover should hint at a brand selection, and bg-surface-hover or bg-surface-secondary-hover for a tappable row or card.

bg-fill-pressed-subtle.description: Light pressed step of bg-fill — the unselected chip while pressed. The same grey as bg-secondary, so on the grey canvas a borderless control loses its fill while pressed and only its label remains. Use bg-fill-pressed-strong where the press must read on either canvas.

bg-fill-pressed-strong.description: Strong pressed step of bg-fill — the chip remove button circle, and any neutral control whose press must read on either canvas. Darker than bg-secondary. Not a disabled colour; use bg-surface-disabled or bg-fill-disabled-subtle for that.

bg-fill-disabled-strong.description: Disabled fill for a control that stays visually solid when disabled — switch tracks, sliders, filled indicators. Use bg-fill-disabled-subtle for the lighter variant.

bg-fill-disabled-subtle.description: Lighter disabled fill — disabled input fields and low-emphasis controls. Use bg-fill-disabled-strong when the disabled element still needs to read as solid.

bg-fill-secondary.description: Low-emphasis neutral fill — segmented control tracks, skeleton blocks. For its interactive states use bg-fill-secondary-hover and bg-fill-secondary-pressed.

bg-fill-secondary-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-secondary — an interactive segmented track or low-emphasis neutral control. For the white control fill use bg-fill-hover.

bg-fill-secondary-pressed.description: Pressed state for bg-fill-secondary — an interactive segmented track or low-emphasis neutral control.

bg-fill-brand.description: Solid brand fill for the highest-emphasis action — primary button default. Pair the label with text-brand-on-bg-fill. For a tinted brand background use bg-surface-brand.

bg-fill-brand-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-brand — primary button hover.

bg-fill-brand-pressed.description: Pressed/active state for bg-fill-brand — primary button pressed.

bg-fill-info-strong.description: Solid informational fill — info badges, counters, status dots. Pair the label with text-info-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-info-strong-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-info-strong on an interactive info element. The label stays text-info-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-info-strong-pressed.description: Pressed state for bg-fill-info-strong on an interactive info element. The label stays text-info-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-info-subtle.description: Tinted informational fill — low-emphasis info badges and tags. Pair the label with text-info-on-bg-fill-subtle.

bg-fill-success-strong.description: Solid success fill — success badges and status dots. Pair the label with text-success-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-success-strong-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-success-strong on an interactive success element. Darker than the rest step, because a lighter green would drop the white label below AA.

bg-fill-success-strong-pressed.description: Pressed state for bg-fill-success-strong on an interactive success element. The label stays text-success-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-success-subtle.description: Tinted success fill — low-emphasis success badges and tags. Pair the label with text-success-on-bg-fill-subtle.

bg-fill-caution-strong.description: Solid caution fill — amber advisory badges and status dots. Pair the label with text-caution-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-caution-strong-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-caution-strong on an interactive caution element. Darker than the rest step, because a lighter amber would drop the white label below AA.

bg-fill-caution-strong-pressed.description: Pressed state for bg-fill-caution-strong on an interactive caution element. The label stays text-caution-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-caution-subtle.description: Tinted caution fill — low-emphasis advisory badges and tags. Pair the label with text-caution-on-bg-fill-subtle.

bg-fill-warning-strong.description: Solid error/destructive fill — destructive primary button default, error badges. Pair the label with text-warning-on-bg-fill-strong.

bg-fill-warning-strong-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-warning-strong — destructive primary button hover.

bg-fill-warning-strong-pressed.description: Pressed/active state for bg-fill-warning-strong — destructive primary button pressed.

bg-fill-warning-subtle.description: Tinted error fill — low-emphasis error badges and tags. Pair the label with text-warning-on-bg-fill-subtle.

bg-fill-inverse.description: Solid inverted fill — dark badges, toasts and controls on a light page. Pair with text-inverse and icon-inverse, and use bg-fill-inverse-hover and bg-fill-inverse-pressed when it is interactive.

bg-fill-inverse-hover.description: Hover state for bg-fill-inverse — an action on a dark toast or a dark control. Lighter than the rest step, since the fill is already near black.

bg-fill-inverse-pressed.description: Pressed state for bg-fill-inverse — an action on a dark toast or a dark control.

text-primary.description: Default text colour — body copy, headings, and any content carrying the main message.

text-secondary.description: Supporting text at lower emphasis — descriptions, captions, secondary list lines.

text-tertiary.description: Lowest-emphasis text — helper text, timestamps, metadata. For input placeholders use text-placeholder. Avoid for content the user must read in order to act.

text-placeholder.description: Placeholder text inside an empty input field. Meets AA on the white control fill (bg-fill) but not on the grey canvas, so keep inputs white. For helper text below a field use text-tertiary.

text-disabled.description: Text inside a disabled control, menu item or list row. Pair with bg-surface-disabled.

text-inverse.description: Text on an inverted background (bg-surface-inverse, bg-fill-inverse) — tooltips, dark toasts. For supporting lines use text-inverse-secondary and for links text-link-inverse.

text-inverse-secondary.description: Supporting text on an inverted background — the subtitle of a dark toast or tooltip. For the main line use text-inverse.

text-inverse-disabled.description: Disabled text on an inverted background. Dimmer than text-inverse-secondary so a disabled item never reads as supporting copy.

text-link.description: Inline hyperlink inside body copy, with text-link-hover and text-link-pressed for its states. For a brand-coloured control label (secondary, tertiary or text button) use text-brand; on dark backgrounds use text-link-inverse.

text-link-hover.description: Hovered inline hyperlink inside body copy. Darker than text-link so the change reads without relying on the underline alone.

text-link-pressed.description: Pressed inline hyperlink inside body copy.

text-link-inverse.description: Inline hyperlink on an inverted background (bg-surface-inverse, bg-fill-inverse) — links inside dark toasts and tooltips. On light backgrounds use text-link.

text-brand.description: Brand-coloured label on a neutral or brand-tinted background — secondary, tertiary and text button labels, selected tab labels. On a solid brand fill use text-brand-on-bg-fill.

text-brand-on-bg-fill.description: Label colour on bg-fill-brand — primary button content. For an icon on the same fill use icon-brand-on-bg-fill. Do not use on tinted brand surfaces, where it will not have contrast.

text-brand-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Brand label colour on a tinted brand surface while hovered — the secondary, tertiary and text button labels. Darker than text-brand so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it. For a label on a solid brand fill use text-brand-on-bg-fill; for brand foreground marks such as the Radio dot use text-brand-hover, which tracks border-brand-hover instead.

text-brand-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Brand label colour on a tinted brand surface while pressed. One step darker than text-brand-on-bg-surface-hover, matching the deeper surface underneath.

text-info.description: Informational text on a neutral or info-tinted surface (bg-surface-info). On a solid info fill use the text-info-on-bg-fill-* variants.

text-info-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Label colour on bg-fill-info-strong and its hover and pressed steps. For an icon on the same fill use icon-info-on-bg-fill-strong.

text-info-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Info label colour on bg-surface-info-hover. Darker than text-info so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-info-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Info label colour on bg-surface-info-pressed. Darker than text-info so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-success.description: Success text on a neutral or success-tinted surface (bg-surface-success). On a solid success fill use the text-success-on-bg-fill-* variants.

text-success-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Label colour on bg-fill-success-strong and its hover and pressed steps. For an icon on the same fill use icon-success-on-bg-fill-strong.

text-success-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Success label colour on bg-surface-success-hover. Darker than text-success so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-success-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Success label colour on bg-surface-success-pressed. Darker than text-success so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-caution.description: Amber advisory text on a neutral or caution-tinted surface. In Cosmos, caution is the amber advisory role; for errors and destructive copy use text-warning.

text-caution-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Label colour on bg-fill-caution-strong and its hover and pressed steps. For an icon on the same fill use icon-caution-on-bg-fill-strong.

text-caution-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Caution label colour on bg-surface-caution-hover. Darker than text-caution so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-caution-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Caution label colour on bg-surface-caution-pressed. Darker than text-caution so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-warning.description: Error and destructive text — validation messages, destructive button labels. In Cosmos, warning is the red error role; for amber advisories use text-caution.

text-warning-hover.description: Hover state for text-warning — destructive secondary and text buttons.

text-warning-pressed.description: Pressed/active state for text-warning — destructive secondary and text buttons.

text-warning-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Label colour on bg-fill-warning-strong — destructive primary button content. For an icon on the same fill use icon-warning-on-bg-fill-strong.

text-warning-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Destructive label colour on a tinted red surface while hovered — the secondary, tertiary and text destructive button labels. Darker than text-warning so the label keeps AA as the surface deepens beneath it.

text-warning-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Destructive label colour on a tinted red surface while pressed. One step darker than text-warning-on-bg-surface-hover, matching the deeper surface underneath.

border.description: Default border and divider — input outlines, card edges, table rules. Use border-secondary where a lighter separation is wanted, border-hover for a hovered outline, and border-inverse on dark backgrounds.

border-hover.description: Hovered neutral outline — input fields and outlined neutral controls under the pointer. For an outline that is strong at rest use border-strong.

border-secondary.description: Lighter divider for dense or nested content — list separators, inner table rules.

border-strong.description: Higher-contrast neutral border — the unchecked Checkbox and Radio outlines, outlines that must stay legible on a tinted surface, and dividers separating major regions. Meets the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 minimum for a control boundary on both canvases. Use border for the default outline and border-disabled-strong for a disabled control.

border-disabled-strong.description: Border of a disabled control that keeps a visible outline — disabled secondary button.

border-disabled-subtle.description: Border of a disabled low-emphasis control — disabled input field.

border-focus.description: Keyboard focus ring. Apply on :focus-visible rather than :focus so the ring does not appear on pointer interaction.

border-brand.description: Brand border on an unfilled control — secondary button default, selected card outline.

border-success.description: Border of a success container (bg-surface-success). For the outline of a validated control use border-success-strong.

border-success-strong.description: Strong green outline for a control in a success state — a validated input field or a confirmed selection. For the edge of a success banner use border-success.

border-warning.description: Border of an error container (bg-surface-warning). For the outline of a destructive control use border-warning-strong.

border-warning-strong.description: Strong red border for a destructive control — destructive secondary button outline.

border-inverse.description: Divider or outline on an inverted background (bg-surface-inverse, bg-fill-inverse) — separators inside dark toasts and tooltips. On light backgrounds use border.

icon.description: Default icon colour, matching text-primary — standalone icons and icons beside primary text.

icon-disabled.description: Icon inside a disabled control on a light background. On the solid disabled fill (bg-fill-disabled-strong) use icon-on-bg-fill-disabled-strong.

icon-on-bg-fill-disabled-strong.description: Icon on the solid disabled fill (bg-fill-disabled-strong) — the tick of a disabled selected Checkbox. For an icon inside a disabled control on a light background use icon-disabled.

icon-inverse.description: Icon on an inverted background (bg-surface-inverse, bg-fill-inverse), matching text-inverse. Use icon-inverse-secondary for supporting icons and icon-inverse-disabled for disabled ones.

icon-inverse-secondary.description: Supporting icon on an inverted background, beside text-inverse-secondary. For the main icon use icon-inverse.

icon-inverse-disabled.description: Disabled icon on an inverted background, matching text-inverse-disabled. Dimmer than icon-inverse-secondary.

icon-tertiary.description: Lowest-emphasis icon — decorative affordances, input adornments, chevrons. Matches text-tertiary; for an icon inside a disabled control use icon-disabled.

icon-brand.description: Brand-coloured icon on a neutral or brand-tinted background. On a solid brand fill use icon-brand-on-bg-fill.

icon-brand-hover.description: Hovered brand icon on a neutral background, tracking text-brand-hover and border-brand-hover. On a tinted brand surface keep the icon in step with the label instead.

icon-brand-pressed.description: Pressed brand icon on a neutral background, tracking text-brand-pressed and border-brand-pressed.

icon-brand-on-bg-fill.description: Icon on bg-fill-brand and its hover and pressed steps — the primary button icon and the selected Checkbox tick. For brand icons on neutral or tinted backgrounds use icon-brand.

icon-brand-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Brand icon on a tinted brand surface while hovered — the icons in secondary, tertiary and text buttons. Tracks text-brand-on-bg-surface-hover so icon and label stay one colour as the surface deepens. For a hovered brand icon on a neutral background use icon-brand-hover.

icon-brand-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Brand icon on a tinted brand surface while pressed — the icons in secondary, tertiary and text buttons. Tracks text-brand-on-bg-surface-pressed so icon and label stay one colour as the surface deepens. For a pressed brand icon on a neutral background use icon-brand-pressed.

icon-success.description: Status icon in a success message or container.

icon-success-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Icon on bg-fill-success-strong — success badges. For a success icon on a neutral or tinted background use icon-success.

icon-success-on-bg-fill-subtle.description: Icon on bg-fill-success-subtle — subtle success badges and tags.

icon-caution.description: Status icon in an amber advisory message or container.

icon-caution-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Icon on bg-fill-caution-strong — amber advisory badges. For a caution icon on a neutral or tinted background use icon-caution.

icon-caution-on-bg-fill-subtle.description: Icon on bg-fill-caution-subtle — subtle advisory badges and tags. Darker than icon-caution, matching text-caution-on-bg-fill-subtle.

icon-warning.description: Status icon in an error message or destructive confirmation.

icon-warning-hover.description: Hovered warning icon on a neutral background, tracking text-warning-hover and border-warning-strong-hover.

icon-warning-pressed.description: Pressed warning icon on a neutral background, tracking text-warning-pressed and border-warning-strong-pressed.

icon-warning-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Icon on bg-fill-warning-strong and its hover and pressed steps — the destructive primary button icon and the selected error Checkbox tick. For a warning icon on a neutral or tinted background use icon-warning.

icon-warning-on-bg-surface-hover.description: Destructive icon on a tinted red surface while hovered — the icons in destructive secondary, tertiary and text buttons. Tracks text-warning-on-bg-surface-hover so icon and label stay one colour. For a hovered warning icon on a neutral background use icon-warning-hover.

icon-warning-on-bg-surface-pressed.description: Destructive icon on a tinted red surface while pressed — the icons in destructive secondary, tertiary and text buttons. Tracks text-warning-on-bg-surface-pressed so icon and label stay one colour. For a pressed warning icon on a neutral background use icon-warning-pressed.

icon-warning-on-bg-fill-subtle.description: Icon on bg-fill-warning-subtle — subtle error badges and tags.

icon-info.description: Status icon in an informational message or container.

icon-info-on-bg-fill-strong.description: Icon on bg-fill-info-strong — info badges and counters. For an info icon on a neutral or tinted background use icon-info.

icon-info-on-bg-fill-subtle.description: Icon on bg-fill-info-subtle — subtle info badges and tags.

transparent.description: Explicit no-fill. Use where a colour token is required but the element must be see-through — the resting background of secondary and text buttons — so the value stays swappable instead of hard-coded to `transparent`.

none.description: No rounding — flush edges, full-bleed media, table cells.

xs.description: Smallest rounding — badges, tags and checkbox corners.

sm.description: Small rounding — small buttons, menu items and inline inputs.

md.description: Default control rounding — medium buttons and inputs.

lg.description: Rounding for large controls and compact containers — large buttons, small cards.

xl.description: Container rounding — cards, panels and modals.

2xl.description: Large container rounding — bottom sheets and hero cards.

3xl.description: Extra-large container rounding for prominent marketing surfaces.

4xl.description: Largest fixed rounding — oversized promotional cards and illustration frames.

full.description: Fully rounded — pills, chips, avatars and icon-only round buttons. A large fixed value that reads as a semicircle at any element height, so it never needs to track the size.

default.description: Default outline thickness — input fields, cards, chips, the Checkbox box and outlined buttons. Use stroke-strong for a heavier control outline and stroke-focus for focus rings.

strong.description: Heavier outline thickness for a control that is drawn as its outline, such as the Radio circle. For focus rings use stroke-focus, which can change independently.

focus.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring on every control. For a resting outline use stroke-default or stroke-strong.

2xs.description: Smallest icon — inline with small labels and in dense table rows.

xs.description: Icon inside small controls — small buttons, chips and input adornments.

sm.description: Icon inside medium controls — the default button and input icon size.

md.description: Default standalone icon — large buttons, list-row leading icons, toolbar actions.

lg.description: Prominent icon — feature rows and compact empty states.

xl.description: Large feature icon — onboarding steps and marketing rows.

2xl.description: Extra-large feature icon — empty states and illustration stand-ins.

3xl.description: Largest icon — hero illustrations and full-screen empty states.

none.description: No space — collapse a gap the layout would otherwise apply.

3xs.description: Hairline gap — between an icon and its label in dense controls.

2xs.description: Tightest usable gap — icon-to-label in small controls, vertical padding of small buttons.

xs.description: Small gap — between a label and its input, between chips in a row, vertical padding of medium buttons.

sm.description: Tight padding — vertical padding of large buttons, horizontal padding of small ones, gap between closely related elements.

md.description: Default spacing step — horizontal padding of medium controls and the gap between fields in a form.

lg.description: Comfortable gap — horizontal padding of large controls and spacing between grouped blocks.

xl.description: Section gap — separation between distinct content blocks inside a card.

2xl.description: Large section gap — separation between content groups on a page.

3xl.description: Large section gap; also the minimum height of a small button.

4xl.description: Generous section gap — separation between major page regions.

5xl.description: Generous section gap; also the minimum height of a medium button.

6xl.description: Layout-scale spacing — page gutters and top-level region separation; also the minimum height of a large button.

7xl.description: Largest spacing step — hero and full-page section separation.

0.description: Fully hidden — the start of a fade-in and the resting value of a state layer. For an element that must stay in the layout while showing the surface behind it, use color.transparent instead, which keeps the property a colour rather than switching it to opacity.

5.description: Faintest perceptible tint — a hairline wash over a surface, or the first frame of a state layer fading in. Below the threshold where most people notice a change on a light background. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

8.description: Barely-there tint, the Material hover weight. On a control, use state-layer-hover, which aliases this step and says when the state-layer pattern applies; this raw step is for non-control surfaces that need the same weight.

10.description: Barely-there tint, the Material focus and pressed weight. On a control, use state-layer-focus or state-layer-pressed, which alias this step; this raw step is for non-control surfaces that need the same weight.

15.description: Light tint — a subtle wash over a surface, or a separator that should read softer than border-subtle. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

16.description: Light tint, the Material dragged weight. On a control, use state-layer-dragged, which aliases this step; this raw step is for non-control surfaces that need the same weight.

20.description: Light veil — dimming a surface without obscuring it, such as an inactive panel beside an active one. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

25.description: Light veil — a soft wash over content that is still meant to be read through. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

30.description: Light veil at the edge of the scrim band — a backdrop over an already-dark surface, where the full scrim would read as solid. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

32.description: The scrim weight, following the Material backdrop value. For a modal, drawer or bottom-sheet backdrop use scrim, which aliases this step and names the colour to pair it with; this raw step is for backdrops the role does not describe.

35.description: Heavier veil than the scrim — a backdrop over light, busy imagery where the scrim does not separate the layers enough. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

40.description: Mid veil — dimming a photo behind overlaid text where the image is light or low in contrast. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

45.description: Mid veil — dimming a photo behind overlaid text, or content behind a loading state. Heavy enough to hold legibility over unknown imagery. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

50.description: Half strength — the midpoint of the ramp, where the layer beneath reads as clearly present but subordinate. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

55.description: Mid veil leaning heavy — content that is visibly inactive but still legible. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

60.description: Mid veil leaning heavy — a busy backdrop that must recede far enough for foreground text to carry the page. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

65.description: Heavy veil — the layer beneath reads as texture rather than as content. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

70.description: Heavy veil — near solid, with just enough of the layer beneath showing to signal that something is there. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

75.description: Heavy veil at three-quarter strength, for a foreground that must dominate completely. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

80.description: Near-solid wash — the layer beneath is a hint, not content. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

85.description: Near-solid wash — for a surface that should read as opaque while still tinting slightly toward what sits behind it. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

90.description: Near-solid wash — the last step at which the layer beneath is perceptible at all. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

95.description: All but opaque — the final frame before a fade-in completes, or a surface needing the faintest trace of what sits behind it. Prefer a role token when one describes the job; ramp steps are for the one-off dimming the roles do not cover.

100.description: Fully visible — the resting value, and the end of a fade-in. Exists so a transition can name both ends with tokens instead of mixing a token with a bare 1.

state-layer-hover.description: Opacity of the tint laid over a control while the pointer rests on it, following the Material hover value. Only for the state-layer pattern, where a separate layer takes the content colour; controls that swap to a solid hover step use bg-fill-*-hover or bg-surface-*-hover instead.

state-layer-focus.description: Opacity of the tint laid over a control while it holds keyboard focus. A state layer at this value does not meet WCAG 1.4.11 on its own — pair it with a focus ring in color.border-focus, as Button and Checkbox do, rather than raising the opacity until it passes.

state-layer-pressed.description: Opacity of the tint laid over a control while it is being pressed. Shares a value with state-layer-focus today, and is a separate token so the pressed feel can be tuned without dragging focus along with it.

state-layer-dragged.description: Opacity of the tint laid over a control while the user drags it — the heaviest state layer, so a lifted item reads as detached from the list it came from.

scrim.description: Opacity of the dim laid over the page behind a modal, drawer or bottom sheet. Apply it to a full-bleed layer filled with color.bg-surface-inverse — that pairing is what makes the scrim track the palette instead of hard-coding a black wash.

card.description: Resting elevation for cards and tiles on the page, just enough lift to separate a white card from either canvas. Use raised once the card is hovered, dragged or pinned above scrolling content.

card-subtle.description: Lighter alternative to card, about half its weight, for tiles and list items where a border would feel heavy. Use card when the element needs to read clearly as lifted, and card-soft for a diffuse look.

card-soft.description: Diffuse alternative to card with almost no edge, for feature and promotional cards that should float softly on the page. Use card-subtle for a lighter touch, and raised once the card is hovered or dragged.

raised.description: Lifted elevation for elements floating a little above the content around them: hovered or dragged cards, sticky headers, floating action buttons. Use overlay for layers that open on top of the page, and sticky-bottom for bars pinned to the bottom edge.

sticky-bottom.description: The raised elevation cast upward, for bars pinned to the bottom of the screen — sticky booking and price footers, bottom navigation. For elements that float above the content below them use raised.

overlay.description: Elevation for transient layers opened over the page without blocking it: menus, dropdowns, popovers, tooltips and toasts. Use modal when the layer blocks the page behind a scrim.

modal.description: Highest elevation, for layers that block the page: dialogs and bottom sheets, always shown over the scrim. Nothing in the product sits above it.

label-text-disabled.description: Colour of the text label in the text (no fill or outline) button when disabled — default intent.

label-text-hover.description: Colour of the text label in the text (no fill or outline) button — default intent, on hover. Darker than the resting label so it holds AA as the tinted background deepens.

label-text-pressed.description: Colour of the text label in the text (no fill or outline) button — default intent, while pressed. Darker than the resting label so it holds AA as the tinted background deepens.

min-height-lg.description: Minimum height of the large button, and the only size that clears the 44px WCAG 2.5.8 target unaided.

min-height-md.description: Minimum height of the medium button. Below the 44px WCAG 2.5.8 target — the host must supply the remaining hit area.

min-height-sm.description: Minimum height of the small button. Well below the 44px WCAG 2.5.8 target — the host must supply the remaining hit area.

min-width.description: Minimum width of every button, the same at all three sizes. One shared value means a stretched button keeps its width when its size changes; buttons still grow to fit longer labels, and short labels such as OK render at this width.

padding-x-lg.description: Horizontal padding of the large button.

padding-x-md.description: Horizontal padding of the medium button.

padding-x-sm.description: Horizontal padding of the small button.

padding-y-lg.description: Vertical padding of the large button. At this size the padded content box lands exactly on min-height-lg.

padding-y-md.description: Vertical padding of the medium button. The rendered height comes from min-height-md rather than from this padding.

padding-y-sm.description: Vertical padding of the small button. The rendered height comes from min-height-sm rather than from this padding.

radius-lg.description: Button corner radius; matches the large and medium sizes by value, which share one radius. Unbound in Figma — see the cornerRadius anomaly in components/button.md.

radius-md.description: Button corner radius; matches the small size by value. Unbound in Figma — the component hardcodes its corner radius per size, so confirm the intended binding before relying on this (see the cornerRadius anomaly in components/button.md).

radius-xl.description: Not a button-box radius: it matches the focused ring at large and medium, which the spec defines as the button radius plus 4. Unbound in Figma like the other radius tokens — see components/button.md.

bg-unselected-default.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked, at rest.

bg-unselected-hover.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked, on hover.

bg-unselected-pressed.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked, while pressed.

bg-unselected-disabled.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked, when disabled.

bg-unselected-error-default.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, at rest.

bg-unselected-error-hover.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, on hover.

bg-unselected-error-pressed.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, while pressed.

bg-unselected-error-disabled.description: Fill of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, when disabled.

bg-selected-default.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked, at rest.

bg-selected-hover.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked, on hover.

bg-selected-pressed.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked, while pressed.

bg-selected-disabled.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked, when disabled.

bg-selected-error-default.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, at rest.

bg-selected-error-hover.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, on hover.

bg-selected-error-pressed.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, while pressed.

bg-selected-error-disabled.description: Fill of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, when disabled.

border-unselected-default.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked, at rest.

border-unselected-hover.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked, on hover.

border-unselected-pressed.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked, while pressed.

border-unselected-disabled.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked, when disabled.

border-unselected-error-default.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, at rest.

border-unselected-error-hover.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, on hover.

border-unselected-error-pressed.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, while pressed.

border-unselected-error-disabled.description: Outline of the checkbox box — unchecked and in the error state, when disabled.

border-selected-default.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked, at rest.

border-selected-hover.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked, on hover. Transparent: the fill darkening to bg-fill-brand-hover is the hover feedback, so no stroke is drawn.

border-selected-pressed.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked, while pressed. Transparent: the fill darkening to bg-fill-brand-pressed is the pressed feedback, so no stroke is drawn.

border-selected-disabled.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked, when disabled.

border-selected-error-default.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, at rest.

border-selected-error-hover.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, on hover. Transparent: the fill change is the hover feedback, so no stroke is drawn.

border-selected-error-pressed.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, while pressed. Transparent: the fill change is the pressed feedback, so no stroke is drawn.

border-selected-error-disabled.description: Outline of the checkbox box — checked and in the error state, when disabled.

icon-selected-default.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked, at rest.

icon-selected-hover.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked, on hover.

icon-selected-pressed.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked, while pressed.

icon-selected-disabled.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked, when disabled.

icon-selected-error-default.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked and in the error state, at rest.

icon-selected-error-hover.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked and in the error state, on hover.

icon-selected-error-pressed.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked and in the error state, while pressed.

icon-selected-error-disabled.description: Colour of the checkmark glyph inside the box — checked and in the error state, when disabled.

label-default.description: Colour of the label text beside the checkbox.

label-disabled.description: Colour of the label text when the checkbox is disabled.

description-default.description: Colour of the helper text below the label.

description-error.description: Colour of the helper text when the checkbox is in the error state — validation messages render here. The label itself does not change colour in the error state.

description-disabled.description: Colour of the helper text when the checkbox is disabled.

focus-ring.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring. Apply on :focus-visible so the ring does not appear on pointer interaction.

focus-ring-error.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring when the checkbox is in the error state.

control-size-sm.description: Width and height of the checkbox box at small size. The box is square, so this is both dimensions; the tappable area is set separately by min-touch-target.

control-size-md.description: Width and height of the checkbox box at medium size.

control-size-lg.description: Width and height of the checkbox box at large size.

icon-size-sm.description: Size of the checkmark glyph inside the box at small size.

icon-size-md.description: Size of the checkmark glyph inside the box at medium size.

icon-size-lg.description: Size of the checkmark glyph inside the box at large size.

radius-sm.description: Corner radius of the checkbox box at small size.

radius-md.description: Corner radius of the checkbox box at medium size.

radius-lg.description: Corner radius of the checkbox box at large size.

radius-xl.description: Corner radius step above radius-lg. The checkbox control ramp has three sizes (sm, md, lg), so this fourth step has no size to pair with — confirm its intended consumer before binding it.

border-width.description: Thickness of the box outline, in every state.

focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between the box and its focus ring.

gap-sm.description: Horizontal gap between the box and its label at small size.

gap-md.description: Horizontal gap between the box and its label at medium size; currently the same value as gap-sm.

gap-lg.description: Horizontal gap between the box and its label at large size.

gap-text.description: Vertical gap between the label and the helper text beneath it.

min-touch-target.description: Minimum tappable area around the checkbox, independent of the visible box size. The hit area must reach this even at small size — do not scale it with control-size-*.

bg-default.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states — at rest.

bg-hover.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states — on hover.

bg-pressed.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states — while pressed.

bg-disabled.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states — when disabled.

bg-error-default.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states, in the error state — at rest.

bg-error-hover.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states, in the error state — on hover.

bg-error-pressed.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states, in the error state — while pressed.

bg-error-disabled.description: Fill of the radio circle in both selected and unselected states, in the error state — when disabled.

border-unselected-default.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected, at rest.

border-unselected-hover.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected, on hover.

border-unselected-pressed.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected, while pressed.

border-unselected-disabled.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected, when disabled.

border-unselected-error-default.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected and in the error state, at rest.

border-unselected-error-hover.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected and in the error state, on hover.

border-unselected-error-pressed.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected and in the error state, while pressed.

border-unselected-error-disabled.description: Outline of the radio circle — unselected and in the error state, when disabled.

border-selected-default.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected, at rest.

border-selected-hover.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected, on hover.

border-selected-pressed.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected, while pressed.

border-selected-disabled.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected, when disabled.

border-selected-error-default.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected and in the error state, at rest.

border-selected-error-hover.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected and in the error state, on hover.

border-selected-error-pressed.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected and in the error state, while pressed.

border-selected-error-disabled.description: Outline of the radio circle — selected and in the error state, when disabled.

dot-selected-default.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected, at rest.

dot-selected-hover.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected, on hover.

dot-selected-pressed.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected, while pressed.

dot-selected-disabled.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected, when disabled.

dot-selected-error-default.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected and in the error state, at rest.

dot-selected-error-hover.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected and in the error state, on hover.

dot-selected-error-pressed.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected and in the error state, while pressed.

dot-selected-error-disabled.description: Colour of the selected dot inside the circle — selected and in the error state, when disabled.

label-default.description: Colour of the label text beside the radio.

label-disabled.description: Colour of the label text when the radio is disabled.

description-default.description: Colour of the helper text below the label.

description-error.description: Colour of the helper text when the radio is in the error state — validation messages render here. The label itself does not change colour in the error state.

description-disabled.description: Colour of the helper text when the radio is disabled.

state-layer-unselected.description: Colour of the focus state layer while the radio is unselected. The state layer takes the colour of the content it belongs to, so it follows the ring rather than the interior.

state-layer-selected.description: Colour of the focus state layer while the radio is selected.

state-layer-error.description: Colour of the focus state layer in the error state, selected or not.

control-size-sm.description: Diameter of the radio circle at small size. The tappable area is set separately by min-touch-target.

control-size-md.description: Diameter of the radio circle at medium size.

control-size-lg.description: Diameter of the radio circle at large size.

dot-size-sm.description: Diameter of the selected dot inside the circle at small size.

dot-size-md.description: Diameter of the selected dot inside the circle at medium size. The only component token that aliases a primitive (spacing.10) rather than a semantic step, because the semantic space scale jumps from 8px to 12px.

dot-size-lg.description: Diameter of the selected dot inside the circle at large size.

radius.description: Corner radius of the radio circle — always fully round. A single token, since the circle keeps its shape across every size.

border-width.description: Thickness of the circle outline, in every state.

state-layer-size-sm.description: Diameter of the focus state layer at small size — twice the control diameter, so it overhangs the circle evenly.

state-layer-size-md.description: Diameter of the focus state layer at medium size — twice the control diameter, so it overhangs the circle evenly.

state-layer-size-lg.description: Diameter of the focus state layer at large size — twice the control diameter, so it overhangs the circle evenly.

state-layer-opacity-focus.description: Opacity of the focus state layer. Aliases opacity.state-layer-focus, the system-wide state-layer value — retune it there, not here. Radio has no focus ring, so this layer is the whole focus affordance; at 1.13–1.20:1 against white it does not meet WCAG 1.4.11, an accepted deviation documented in components/radio.md.

gap-sm.description: Horizontal gap between the circle and its label at small size.

gap-md.description: Horizontal gap between the circle and its label at medium size; currently the same value as gap-sm.

gap-lg.description: Horizontal gap between the circle and its label at large size.

gap-text.description: Vertical gap between the label and the helper text beneath it.

min-touch-target.description: Minimum tappable area around the radio, independent of the visible circle size. The hit area must reach this even at small size — do not scale it with control-size-*.

bg-unselected-default.description: Fill of the chip container — unselected, at rest and on keyboard focus. White in every border setting: a borderless chip belongs on the grey bg-secondary canvas, a bordered chip on white pages and cards.

bg-unselected-hover.description: Fill of the chip container — unselected, on hover. The same grey as bg-secondary and as the pressed fill, so hover and pressed differ only by the border, and a borderless chip on the grey canvas loses its fill.

bg-unselected-pressed.description: Fill of the chip container — unselected, while pressed. The same grey as bg-secondary, so on the grey canvas a borderless chip loses its fill while pressed and only its label remains.

bg-unselected-disabled.description: Fill of the chip container — unselected, when disabled. The same light neutral in both selection states, so an inert chip does not read as chosen.

bg-selected-default.description: Fill of the chip container — selected, at rest and on keyboard focus. A tint rather than a solid brand fill, so a row of selected chips stays calm; the label and border carry the brand colour.

bg-selected-hover.description: Fill of the chip container — selected, on hover.

bg-selected-pressed.description: Fill of the chip container — selected, while pressed.

bg-selected-disabled.description: Fill of the chip container — selected, when disabled. The same light neutral in both selection states, so an inert chip does not read as chosen.

border-unselected-default.description: Outline of the chip — unselected, at rest and on keyboard focus. Painted only when the border is switched on. A divider-weight grey on purpose: the label, not the edge, identifies the chip, so this sits below the 3:1 of border-strong by design.

border-unselected-hover.description: Outline of the chip — unselected, on hover. Painted only when the border is switched on. Keeps the resting grey.

border-unselected-pressed.description: Outline of the chip — unselected, while pressed. Painted only when the border is switched on. Darkens to border-strong, which is the only thing that separates pressed from hover.

border-unselected-disabled.description: Outline of the chip — unselected, when disabled. Painted only when the border is switched on.

border-selected-default.description: Outline of the chip — selected, at rest and on keyboard focus. Painted only when the border is switched on.

border-selected-hover.description: Outline of the chip — selected, on hover. Painted only when the border is switched on.

border-selected-pressed.description: Outline of the chip — selected, while pressed. Painted only when the border is switched on.

border-selected-disabled.description: Outline of the chip — selected, when disabled. Painted only when the border is switched on.

label-unselected-default.description: Colour of the chip label — unselected, in every enabled state. It keeps this colour on hover, pressed and focus; only the fill and border move.

label-selected-default.description: Colour of the chip label — selected, at rest and on keyboard focus.

label-selected-hover.description: Colour of the chip label — selected, on hover. Darkens with the fill so it holds AA contrast on bg-selected-hover.

label-selected-pressed.description: Colour of the chip label — selected, while pressed. Darkens with the fill so it holds AA contrast on bg-selected-pressed.

label-disabled.description: Colour of the chip label when disabled, whether or not the chip is selected.

secondary-text-default.description: Colour of the optional secondary line under the chip label, in every enabled state and both selection states. Use it for supporting detail such as a price or a date, never for the chip name.

secondary-text-disabled.description: Colour of the secondary line under the chip label when the chip is disabled.

icon-unselected-default.description: Colour of the leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph — unselected, in every enabled state. Does not apply to the leading image, which keeps its own colours.

icon-selected-default.description: Colour of the leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph — selected, in every enabled state. Does not apply to the leading image.

icon-disabled.description: Colour of the leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph when the chip is disabled. The leading image is not recoloured; desaturate it in code if needed.

remove-bg-unselected-hover.description: Circle behind the remove glyph of a removable chip — unselected, when the remove button itself is hovered. Transparent at rest.

remove-bg-unselected-pressed.description: Circle behind the remove glyph of a removable chip — unselected, while the remove button itself is pressed.

remove-bg-selected-hover.description: Circle behind the remove glyph of a removable chip — selected, when the remove button itself is hovered.

remove-bg-selected-pressed.description: Circle behind the remove glyph of a removable chip — selected, while the remove button itself is pressed.

focus-ring.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring around the chip, and around the remove button of a removable chip. Apply on focus-visible so the ring does not appear on pointer interaction.

min-height-sm.description: Minimum height of a one-line chip at small size. The chip hugs its content, so it grows past this when the secondary line is on. Not the tap target; see min-touch-target.

min-height-md.description: Minimum height of a one-line chip at medium size. The chip hugs its content, so it grows past this when the secondary line is on. Not the tap target; see min-touch-target.

min-height-lg.description: Minimum height of a one-line chip at large size. The chip hugs its content, so it grows past this when the secondary line is on. Not the tap target; see min-touch-target.

padding-x-sm.description: Left and right padding inside the chip at small size, on both sides whether or not an icon or image sits there.

padding-x-md.description: Left and right padding inside the chip at medium size, on both sides whether or not an icon or image sits there.

padding-x-lg.description: Left and right padding inside the chip at large size, on both sides whether or not an icon or image sits there.

padding-y-sm.description: Top and bottom padding inside the chip at small size. A floor for the two-line chip; the one-line height comes from min-height.

padding-y-md.description: Top and bottom padding inside the chip at medium size. A floor for the two-line chip; the one-line height comes from min-height. Currently the same value as padding-y-sm.

padding-y-lg.description: Top and bottom padding inside the chip at large size. A floor for the two-line chip; the one-line height comes from min-height.

gap.description: Horizontal gap between each slot and the label at every size: leading image or icon before it, trailing icon or remove button after it. One value for all sizes so glyphs never crowd the text on small chips.

icon-size-sm.description: Size of the leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph at small size.

icon-size-md.description: Size of the leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph at medium size.

icon-size-lg.description: Size of the leading icon, trailing icon and remove glyph at large size.

image-size-sm.description: Width and height of the circular leading image at small size. Matches icon-size so swapping icon for image never changes the chip height.

image-size-md.description: Width and height of the circular leading image at medium size. Matches icon-size so swapping icon for image never changes the chip height.

image-size-lg.description: Width and height of the circular leading image at large size. Matches icon-size so swapping icon for image never changes the chip height.

radius-sm.description: Corner radius of the chip container at small size. A rounded rectangle rather than a pill, so two-line chips do not grow tall end caps.

radius-md.description: Corner radius of the chip container at medium size. Currently the same value as radius-sm.

radius-lg.description: Corner radius of the chip container at large size, one step rounder so the corner stays in proportion to the 40px chip.

image-radius.description: Corner radius of the leading image in the circle shape, the default, used by both chips. For the square shape, use image-radius-square.

image-radius-square.description: Corner radius of the leading image in the square shape, used by both chips for photos and thumbnails that read better uncropped, such as destinations or hotels. Softened slightly so it sits well inside the rounded chip. For the circle shape, use image-radius.

gap-text.description: Vertical gap between the label and the secondary line; the line heights alone separate them.

border-width.description: Thickness of the chip outline, in every state, when the border is switched on.

focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring around the chip and its remove button.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between the chip edge and its focus ring.

focus-ring-radius-sm.description: Corner radius of the focus ring at small size. Always the chip radius plus 4, so the ring stays concentric with the corner it surrounds 4px outside it.

focus-ring-radius-md.description: Corner radius of the focus ring at medium size. Always the chip radius plus 4. Currently the same value as focus-ring-radius-sm.

focus-ring-radius-lg.description: Corner radius of the focus ring at large size. Always the chip radius plus 4, so it follows radius-lg.

min-touch-target.description: Minimum tappable height of the chip, independent of its visible size. Small and medium chips are shorter than this, so expand the hit area in code — do not scale it with min-height-*.

remove-min-touch-target.description: Minimum tappable area of the remove button on a removable chip, the WCAG 2.5.8 floor. Expand the hit area around the glyph in code without growing the chip.

vertical-padding-y-sm.description: Top and bottom padding inside the vertical chip at small size. Deeper than the one-line chip padding-y because the vertical chip has no min-height; the side padding reuses padding-x.

vertical-padding-y-md.description: Top and bottom padding inside the vertical chip at medium size. Deeper than the one-line chip padding-y because the vertical chip has no min-height; the side padding reuses padding-x.

vertical-icon-size-sm.description: Size of the leading icon above the label in the vertical chip at small size. One step larger than the one-line chip icon-size because the icon leads the chip rather than decorating the label.

vertical-icon-size-md.description: Size of the leading icon above the label in the vertical chip at medium size. One step larger than the one-line chip icon-size because the icon leads the chip rather than decorating the label.

vertical-gap-sm.description: Vertical gap between the leading icon and the text block in the vertical chip at small size. For the gap beside a label or secondary trailing icon, use vertical-gap-trailing.

vertical-gap-md.description: Vertical gap between the leading icon and the text block in the vertical chip at medium size. For the gap beside a label or secondary trailing icon, use vertical-gap-trailing.

vertical-label-trailing-icon-size-sm.description: Size of the trailing icon beside the label in the vertical chip at small size, sized to the label line height. For the icon beside the secondary line, use vertical-secondary-trailing-icon-size.

vertical-label-trailing-icon-size-md.description: Size of the trailing icon beside the label in the vertical chip at medium size, sized to the label line height. For the icon beside the secondary line, use vertical-secondary-trailing-icon-size.

vertical-secondary-trailing-icon-size-sm.description: Size of the trailing icon beside the secondary line in the vertical chip at small size, sized to the secondary line height. For the icon beside the label, use vertical-label-trailing-icon-size.

vertical-secondary-trailing-icon-size-md.description: Size of the trailing icon beside the secondary line in the vertical chip at medium size, sized to the secondary line height. For the icon beside the label, use vertical-label-trailing-icon-size.

vertical-gap-trailing.description: Horizontal gap between the label or secondary line and its trailing icon in the vertical chip, at every size. For the gap between the leading icon and the text, use vertical-gap.

vertical-gap-text.description: Vertical gap between the label and the secondary line in the vertical chip, at every size. The one-line chip uses gap-text instead.

vertical-radius-md.description: Corner radius of the vertical chip at medium size, rounder than the one-line chip because the chip is taller. The small vertical chip uses radius-sm.

vertical-focus-ring-radius-md.description: Corner radius of the focus ring around the medium vertical chip: vertical-radius-md plus the 4 px outset, so the ring stays concentric. The small vertical chip uses focus-ring-radius-sm.

vertical-image-size-sm.description: Width and height of the circular leading image above the label in the vertical chip at small size, one step larger than vertical-icon-size so a photo or logo stays legible. The corner radius is image-radius. A chip shows the leading image or the leading icon, never both.

vertical-image-size-md.description: Width and height of the circular leading image above the label in the vertical chip at medium size, one step larger than vertical-icon-size so a photo or logo stays legible. The corner radius is image-radius. A chip shows the leading image or the leading icon, never both.
